summary: Added two sections to templates/scout_prompt_template.md: (1) '## How to Explore' section after '## Instructions' with 4 bullet points guiding scouts to start with entry points, trace imports/call chains, read adjacent test files, and check for existing patterns to follow. (2) '### Calibration Anchors' subsection after the Node Summary example table with Effort (1-5 from trivial one-liner to complex cross-cutting), Risk (1-5 from safe isolated to critical paths/public APIs), and Uncertainty (1-5 from well-understood to significant unknowns) scales. All template variable placeholders preserved. pnpm build passes.
